behavior: The app is a modern fintech shell: a sidebar with a profile switcher and account menu, a personal dashboard with balance and actions, and a phone tab bar
acceptance: Desktop: a sidebar with the profile switcher at the top (opens a smooth panel to switch profiles or add one), navigation by profile type (Overview, Balances, Activity work; pages not built yet are shown disabled as Soon per type, as the owner chose: Analytics for all, Invoices for freelancers, Checkout and Developers for merchants), and the signed-in account at the bottom (global settings: theme, a disabled Settings item marked Soon, sign out). Phones: a bottom tab bar with working pages only and the switcher as a sheet. Built through Impeccable (direction contract), then an Impeccable finish review and an independent review before commit

The personal dashboard shows a total balance card with Send, Receive, Transfer and Withdraw (only Receive works now; a press on the others shows why, on touch too), balances by chain and token, and recent activity; Receive keeps the full address, QR code and exact network and token warning; axe finds no serious or critical violation; the live Playwright test covers desktop and phone
notes: 2026-10-09 owner decided 2026-10-10 (answers to two questions): per-type nav = "Show future pages disabled" (Invoices for freelancers, Checkout and Developers for merchants, Analytics for all, shown as Soon, never links); account menu = "Add a disabled Settings item" (Settings shown as Soon)
